channel.title: TuneCue
channel.description: Stage MIDI control for Auto-Tune in UAD Console

item.title: Version 0.2.4
item.description:
What changed

"Console not reachable" now says which of the two things is wrong. With UAD Console running and no Auto-Tune loaded in it, the app blamed Console. It now says the plugin is not loaded, and picks it up on its own when you load it.

No more flicker. With no plugin loaded the window rebuilt itself once a second; the Cues page also stuttered every time it opened. Clearing or renaming a cue updates the tile straight away.

The version is beside the name, where the byline used to be.
